source.footage: Generated with Gemini Omni (gemini-omni-1.2-flash), fictional actor, labelled as AI on every platform. Canberk approved the actor on 2026-11-06. Same clip and audio as 2026-11-10-tape-actor.
source.why: The approved tape-actor film, seen through the real Ghost Light Tape room: the app's camera with him in it, the app's own prompter, REC rolling on his action, stopping on his cut, rolling again.
source.app: Ghost Light web preview (ghostlight-web/serve.sh), flow flows/tape-actor-app.json, FAKE_CAM = actor.mp4 with a 4s held first frame in front. Ear words are timed on the camera's clock to his words; the app's own tape-cues.ts decides. Camera to clip offset measured by frame matching: clip second 0 = recording second 3.55 (within one frame, 83 samples). One tap: the app ignores the ear while a take plays back, so the flow taps the review's x (Back to the camera) at clip 7.5s; every REC change is by voice.

monologue.author: William Shakespeare
monologue.sql: select m.id, m.character_name, p.title, p.author from monologues m join plays p on p.id=m.play_id where m.text ilike 'Now is the winter of our discontent%'
